baseItems.name: Up to 300 Watt solar system with MPPT solar charger
baseItems.whatItIs: Rooftop solar panels with a smart MPPT charge controller that feeds the house batteries.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: The sun tops up your batteries every day you're parked, so you can stay off the grid longer.

baseItems.name: 20Amp DC-DC Battery Charger
baseItems.whatItIs: Charges the house batteries from the van's alternator while you drive.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A few hours on the road refills the batteries, without ever draining the van's own starting battery.

baseItems.name: 460Ah Smart Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery System
baseItems.whatItIs: 460 amp hours of lithium iron phosphate storage with a battery monitor, fusing, a main disconnect and all the wiring.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Runs the fridge, fan, lights and outlets for days off the grid, and you can see exactly how much power is left.

baseItems.name: 3000Watt power inverter/charger (pure sine wave)
baseItems.whatItIs: Turns battery power into clean 110V household power, up to 3,000 watts, and charges the batteries when you plug in.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Run the cooktop, a coffee maker or a laptop from the battery, with power that is safe for electronics.

baseItems.name: 3x 110v electrical outlets with USB/A&C
baseItems.whatItIs: Three household outlets with built-in USB-A and USB-C ports, placed where you use them.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Charge phones and plug in appliances without adapters or extension cords.

baseItems.name: 30Amp shore power electrical plugin
baseItems.whatItIs: A 30-amp inlet on the outside of the van, with a 25-foot cord.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Plug into campground or home power to run everything and charge the batteries at the same time.

baseItems.name: 33 gallon freshwater tank (space saving, over the wheel well tank)
baseItems.whatItIs: A 33-gallon tank shaped to sit over the wheel well, with the pump, filter, tank sensor, fill port and all the lines.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Days of drinking, cooking and washing water, without giving up floor or cabinet space.

baseItems.name: Greywater System
baseItems.whatItIs: A holding tank that collects the water from the sink, with a drain valve to empty it.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Keeps used water off the campsite, so you can camp anywhere the rules require it.

baseItems.name: Thetford electric flush cassette toilet
baseItems.whatItIs: A Thetford cassette toilet with electric flush, emptied through its own exterior service door.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A real bathroom in the van at night or in bad weather, and simple to empty at any dump station or toilet.

baseItems.name: Quick connect outdoor shower
baseItems.whatItIs: A hot and cold shower connection at the rear doors that clicks on when you need it.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Rinse off after a hike, a swim or a muddy trail before you climb back in.

baseItems.name: Electric water heater
baseItems.whatItIs: A compact electric water heater for the sink and the shower.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Hot water for dishes and showers whenever you're on shore power or running the inverter.

baseItems.name: Basic Insulation package
baseItems.whatItIs: Insulation in the walls, roof and doors, with sound deadening on the floor, walls and doors.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Keeps the van warmer in winter and cooler in summer, and makes it quieter on the road.

baseItems.name: Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan with remote
baseItems.whatItIs: A ten-speed reversible roof fan with a rain hood and a remote control.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Pulls out cooking smells and moisture, and on many nights it is all the cooling you need, even in the rain.

baseItems.name: 12v roof mounted evaporative cooler
baseItems.whatItIs: A 12-volt roof unit that cools the air by evaporating water, using a fraction of the power of an air conditioner.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Real cooling in dry heat like Arizona's, run straight off the batteries.

baseItems.name: Espar, diesel powered, cabin heater (gasoline engines need to have fuel tank tapped prior to bringing van to Papago)
baseItems.whatItIs: An Espar heater that burns a little fuel from the van's tank to heat the cabin, with a thermostat.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Warm mornings and nights in the cold, with very little fuel and almost no battery power.

baseItems.name: Premium Bamboo countertop with choice of stain color
baseItems.whatItIs: A solid bamboo countertop, finished in the stain color you choose.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A hard-wearing work surface that looks like furniture, matched to your van.

baseItems.name: Stainless steel undermount sink
baseItems.whatItIs: A stainless steel sink mounted under the countertop, with a hot and cold faucet.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Easy to wipe crumbs straight in, and hot water for the dishes.

baseItems.name: Portable, single burner, induction cooktop
baseItems.whatItIs: A single induction burner you can use on the counter or take outside.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Cook without propane, and move the cooking outdoors on a nice night.

baseItems.name: 12v, 85 Liter refrigerator with freezer (black finish)
baseItems.whatItIs: An 85-liter, 12-volt compressor fridge with a freezer section, in a black finish.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Fresh food and cold drinks for days between stores, on very little battery.

baseItems.name: The Wood Veneer Hub acoustic slat panel ceiling with integrated strip lighting
baseItems.whatItIs: A wood veneer acoustic slat ceiling from The Wood Veneer Hub, with dimmable LED strip lighting built into it.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: The first thing everyone notices inside. It softens sound and gives the van warm, even light.

baseItems.name: Painted shiplap walls
baseItems.whatItIs: Shiplap wall panels, painted.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A clean, cozy look that wipes clean and stands up to van life.

baseItems.name: Luxury vinyl plank, wood style flooring
baseItems.whatItIs: Waterproof luxury vinyl plank in a wood style, laid over an insulated subfloor.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Looks like wood, shrugs off sand, mud and spills, and stays warm underfoot.

baseItems.name: 3x overhead cabinets
baseItems.whatItIs: Three overhead cabinets with LED lighting underneath, built from CNC-cut Baltic birch.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Storage up and out of the way for clothes, food and gear.

baseItems.name: Under counter, double-door, cabinet
baseItems.whatItIs: A double-door cabinet under the counter.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Room for pots, pans and the bigger kitchen things.

baseItems.name: Under counter drawer cabinet
baseItems.whatItIs: A cabinet of drawers under the counter.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Keeps utensils and small things organized and easy to reach.

baseItems.name: Under counter storage cabinet
baseItems.whatItIs: A storage cabinet under the counter.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: One more place to put things away, so the van stays tidy.

baseItems.name: Under bed/garage storage
baseItems.whatItIs: A garage under the bed, reached from the rear doors.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Bikes, boards, chairs and tools ride here, out of the living space.

baseItems.name: Floor to ceiling closet with shelves and clothes hanging rod
baseItems.whatItIs: A full-height closet with shelves and a hanging rod.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Your clothes hang and stay folded, the way they do at home.

baseItems.name: Memory foam, size full bed
baseItems.whatItIs: A full-size memory foam mattress on a fixed bed platform.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A real bed that's always made, so you sleep like you do at home.

baseItems.name: Swivel passenger and driver seats
baseItems.whatItIs: Driver and passenger seats that turn to face the living area.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Two more comfortable seats in the van the moment you park.

baseItems.name: Carbon monoxide and smoke detector
baseItems.whatItIs: A combined carbon monoxide and smoke alarm.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Peace of mind every night you sleep in the van.

baseItems.name: Fire extinguisher
baseItems.whatItIs: A mounted fire extinguisher, within reach.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: The one thing you hope never to use, right where you need it.

baseItems.name: Lagun swivel/adjustable table
baseItems.whatItIs: A Lagun table that swivels and tilts, with a bench seat and a fold-down table out of the sliding door.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A table for meals and laptop work that swings out of the way when you don't need it.

baseItems.name: Passenger side, sliding door window with screen
baseItems.whatItIs: A window in the sliding door that opens, with a bug screen, plus privacy curtains for the cab and windows.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Fresh air and a cross-breeze without the bugs, and privacy when you want it.

baseItems.name: Bunk window with screen
baseItems.whatItIs: An opening window beside the bed, with a bug screen.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A breeze and a view from bed.
